name: UMMTO Data Center HPC/AI & Cloud Prive
notes: University tender covered acquisition/installation of a Data Center HPC/AI and private cloud solution; a May 2025 official university report says the minister launched works and visited the future data center premises.

name: Mohammadia Data Center / Data Center 1
developer: High Commission for Digitalization; Huawei Consortium
notes: National Data Center 1 at Mohammadia, Algiers, part of Algeria's National Digital Services Center; APS reported Tier III Design certification in February 2026 after the Huawei agreement for the national digital services data center.

name: eBS / WebServices Data Center
notes: eBS says its data center is in the multi-tenant Sidi Abdellah Cyber Park, with 85 sq m split into production and expansion rooms; Data Center Map lists the WebServices by eBS site at Sidi Abdallah Cyber Parc with 2 MW.

name: AYRADE DC 1 (TASSILI)
notes: Data Center Map lists AYRADE DC 1 at Centre des affaires Cyber Parc Sidi Abdellah Rahmania, Algiers, offering cabinets, servers, remote hands, bare metal and public cloud; AYRADE describes itself as an Algerian cloud/data-hosting provider authorized by ARPCE.

name: ICOSNET Algiers DATA CENTER
notes: Aggregate listings identify ICOSNET's Algiers DATA CENTER at Centre commercial El-Qods, 6th level of the central tower, Cheraga, Algiers, offering hosting/housing services.

name: APN Parliament Data Center
notes: Aggregate data center listings describe an APN Parliament Data Center in Algiers, inaugurated on October 31, 2024, for processing, storage, archiving and security devices.

name: Ministry of Housing Secondary Data Center at OPGI Djelfa
developer: Ministry of Housing, Urbanism and the City
notes: Official ministry consultation 20/2025 covers acquisition, installation and configuration of two firewalls at the secondary data center located at OPGI Djelfa.

name: KOTAMA AGRI-FOOD Datacenter Network Security Project
notes: Tender for redundant NGFW network solution includes a datacenter lot; withdrawal address is KOTAMA AGRI-FOOD's site at RN 43 El Achouat, Taher, Jijel. Treated as internal enterprise datacenter activity, not a colocation facility.
